title: What is an automation? Definition and example | 50agents
description: An automation runs the same steps every time an event happens or a schedule comes round, with no person starting it. A plain definition and an example.
definition: An automation is a set of steps that runs the same way each time an event happens or a schedule comes round.
It follows rules, not judgement, so the same input gives the same result.

example.ask: Set up an automation: every new Stripe payment is added as a row to my Google Sheet with the customer, amount and date
example.why: Each new payment adds a row, the same way every time, with no AI.

build.name: Payments sheet
build.line: every Stripe payment, one row each
build.when: When a payment succeeds in Stripe
does: Adds a row to your Sheet

rows.label: Who decides the steps

rows.a: An app event or a schedule
rows.b: A schedule, or when you ask it
